title: Fix image upload error and share function on HKLO blog

requirements.text: Fix the image upload failure on the Create Post page. The error 'Kunde inte skapa inlägget. Försök med en mindre bild eller försök igen.' occurs because images are too large for the Motoko canister. Implement aggressive canvas-based compression on the frontend in useImageUpload.ts: resize images to a maximum of 1200px on the longest side, compress to JPEG at quality 0.6, and enforce a hard limit of 800 KB per image after compression before submitting to the backend. Display a clear error message if a single image still exceeds the limit after compression.

quotes: Kunde inte skapa inlägget. Försök med en mindre bild eller försök igen.
Fixad bildhantering – canvas-baserad komprimering på frontend

acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a large photo (e.g. a standard smartphone photo) compresses it below 800 KB before submission
Post creation succeeds with a compressed image without showing the error message
If an image cannot be compressed below 800 KB, a user-facing error in Swedish is shown before submission
Image preview is shown after compression, not the original file

requirements.text: Increase the backend Motoko actor's tolerance for image data by raising the per-image blob size limit to at least 900 KB (from any lower existing limit), and ensure that the createPost and updatePost functions return a meaningful error variant when an image still exceeds the limit so the frontend can surface it correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend accepts image blobs up to 900 KB without rejecting the call
Backend returns a typed error (e.g. #imageTooLarge) when a single image exceeds the limit
Existing posts and images are not affected by the change

requirements.text: Fix the share function on post cards and the post detail page. The share button in PostCard.tsx and PostDetailPage.tsx should copy the canonical post URL (e.g. https://hkloblogg-nav.caffeine.xyz/post/<id>) to the clipboard using the Clipboard API, and display a brief Swedish confirmation toast/tooltip ('Länk kopierad!') after a successful copy. Handle browsers where the Clipboard API is unavailable by falling back to a prompt with the URL.

quotes: Dela funktionen verkar inte fungera. Felsök funktionen
Fungerande dela-funktion – dela inlägg via kopierad URL
Dela-funktionen fungerar inte – behöver felsökas och åtgärdas

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the share button on a PostCard copies the correct post URL to the clipboard
Clicking the share button on the PostDetailPage copies the correct post URL to the clipboard
A Swedish confirmation message 'Länk kopierad!' appears briefly after copying
The function does not throw an uncaught error in any supported browser

constraints: Do not change the existing data model or stable variable structure in the Motoko backend without a migration file
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve all existing routes and authentication logic in App.tsx
nonGoals: Rebuilding the entire platform from scratch
Adding new features beyond fixing image upload and the share function
Changing the visual design or color palette
Adding social media sharing integrations (only clipboard copy is in scope)
